name: marketplace
description: Full-stack marketplace (Avito-like) — Next.js + Express + PostgreSQL + Redis + ЮKassa

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api,worker -c cyan,magenta,yellow "pnpm --filter @marketplace/web dev" "pnpm --filter @marketplace/api dev" "pnpm --filter @marketplace/worker dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @marketplace/shared build && pnpm --filter @marketplace/db build && pnpm --filter @marketplace/api build && pnpm --filter @marketplace/web build && pnpm --filter @marketplace/worker build
